verdict.rationale: A explains more: it ties the FY2025 margin rebound to FY2024's AIPR&D and is cleaner prose. But it inverts the royalty-offset direction in the cost-of-sales passage, asserts multi-year inventory growth from one year's figure, and leans on a misleading 95.6% operating-income CAGR. B attributes claims more carefully, discloses a data-quality caveat and adds the ROE peer gap and SBC share. It is clunkier, and its 'third consecutive year' claim is weakly supported.
